samples.title: Gradient in the format that scores
samples.subject: Geography
samples.script: Trig beacon at one thousand two hundred metres, spot height at nine hundred - and on a one to fifty thousand map they are four comma five centimetres apart. Gradient equals vertical interval over horizontal equivalent. Vertical: three hundred metres. Horizontal: four comma five centimetres times fifty thousand - two thousand two hundred and fifty metres. Divide both sides by three hundred. Answer: one in seven comma five - always stated as one to x, units cancelled, working shown. That exact format is what the memorandum rewards.
